typed_texts.text: Please Prepare the boat and crew accordingly
Real Time Booking Alerts to Slack from Sheets
Automatically send new bokking details from Google Sheets to Slack ensuring you crew receives instant clear alerts
This Zap templet streamline booking communication for Salt and Stone Coastal Tours by automatically delivering real time alerts to the team via Slack The workflow is trriggered whenever
a new booking record is adde
d to a Google Sheets database which acts as the central source of truth for all reservations Once a new row is detected Zapier instantly captures
key booking details including Guest Name Experience Type Boat Ass
The automation then formats this data into a clean structured Slack message and it directly to a dedicated #crewalerts channel The message uses clear
labling and bold formatting to ensure that critical infrmation is easy to read at glance even in fast paced dock envi
This eliminates the need for manual checking of emails or spreadsheets and reduces the ri
of missed or delayed booking updates
Designed as a set and sorget
system this Zap improves operation efficiency enhances team coordination and ensures that the crew is always
prepared ahead of scheduled departures It is especially useful for small teams managing high value time sensitive bookings where immediate visibility is essential for smooth service delivery
